closed_items.unknown: Which physical D3 terminal reaches V082. Current D3.L=GND, D3.R=H_RX_VDD and D3.S=H_RX_RF_SENSE are provisional; none is presently assigned to VDD.
closed_items.next_action: Measure V082 to each of D3's three pads. Record low-ohm continuity separately from diode/resistive readings.
closed_items.closed_when: The actual pad is identified and conflicting modeled branches are corrected, without blindly merging VDD and the receiver supply.

resolution.result: User identifies D3.L=GND and D3.R=VDD through V082. Move only D3.R off the hypothetical receiver supply. D3.S-to-R42 measures 1.2 ohm (resistor end not stated; photo selects pad2). Signal function remains with E06 and candidate identity with I01.

rails.name: BATTERY+
rails.path: Battery positive -> Q1 single pad/native3 (candidate drain); TP14/R43.2 on the raw side.
rails.basis: User battery-path report; TP14 raw-side placement from photo plus V015-TP14/R43.2 confirmation.

rails.name: VSYS
rails.board_label: No printed net name; user-approved name
rails.path: Q1.L/native2 -> U5/MX512H pin4; L1.1 and L2.1 supply sides.
rails.basis: User-confirmed shared supply; filter terminal numbering is photo-derived. Do not join their opposite ends.

rails.name: VDD
rails.path: TP103, PIC20/C32, U5 pin1/VCC, V064/V063/V075/V082. D3.R via V082 is user-confirmed.
rails.basis: User via/test-point continuity. Distinct from VSYS and BATTERY+.

rails.name: VREF
rails.path: TP104, PIC4/RA2/V035/C39, R21.2/V071. U3.5 and R22 D/left/model2 at 1 ohm.
rails.basis: User-confirmed core plus U3.5/R22 D/left. R48.2 removed: user annotation groups it with R25/R47/C42; R23 branch rejected. PIC21/RB0/V026 explicitly withdrawn; TP16-VREF measured 800 kohm.

rails.name: GND
rails.basis: User ground reports and matched rear copper; association of every candidate branch is not thereby proved.

milestones.name: Topology complete
milestones.criterion: Populated components and functional block interfaces have supported connections; candidate functions/polarities are compatible and remaining exceptions individually documented.

milestones.name: Value/package complete
milestones.criterion: Required values and geometry recovered; exact manufacturer/ratings separated from equivalent design choices. Routed PCB remains a separate deliverable.

population_note: Open pads include empty options, test pads and internally NC pins. Zero open PIC pads does not prove every onward route.
completed: 150 catalog entries on one A2 sheet, with 20 stock and 4 authorized custom symbol definitions in use.
All PIC pads have modeled local nets; user-confirmed tuning controls and H-bridge INA/INB routes are retained.
BATTERY+, VSYS, VDD, VREF and GND are distinguished; L1/L2 supply sides both connect to VSYS.
Reported continuity, resistance and negative results are preserved separately from inferred connections.
Original ZIP and 26 original photo hashes are preserved; native/model net partitions match.
User U3.5-VREF and R22 D/left at 1 ohm; R22 E/right 10 kohm away. J3.3-GND 1 ohm; J3.2-GND 290 kohm. R23-VREF and old J3 role hypotheses withdrawn.
Batch2: U3.6-R23 B 1 ohm / C 5.6 kohm; J3.2-R38 K 1 ohm / J 10 kohm; R22 E-GND 1 ohm. Extra U3.6-R22 E 400 kohm recorded as an indirect path.
R23 right / C40 lower / R42 upper: user 1 ohm for both joins, also clear surface copper. R23 endpoint resolved; old C40 detector-output association withdrawn.
U7 empty option mapped to J3: U7.1-J3.3 GND, U7.2-J3.2 signal, U7.3-J3.1 PIR supply. TP16-to-TP11/TP17 each 400 kohm; direct joins excluded.
PIC21/RB0 -> TP16 -> Q2.S confirmed; old PIC21-VREF removed. TP16-VREF 0.8 Mohm, not a wire. RA2/V035 and receiver bias retain VREF.

User confirms R41 right end reaches J1 VPP; annotated J6/Q9/R35/R36 option copper mapped.
U6A lower-right pad is GND; all three empty option pads now mapped.
v0.9.24 removes unsupported TP9 from active inventory, retains photographed C49, and moves D4-D6 / Q9-J6 / U6A into their circuit blocks. No measured net membership changes.
